sources.title: Kotoba-Whisper-v2.1 Open-source Japanese Speech Recognition Model ...
sources.snippet: Kotoba-Whisper-v2.1 is a Japanese automatic speech recognition (ASR) model based on Whisper, integrating an additional post-processing stack that automatically adds punctuation marks.
